salient_findings: Dark brown longitudinal pigment band on the toenail
Nail thickening over the pigmented band
Pigment extending to the proximal nail fold
key_facts: New pigmented lesion on the left second toenail
Lesion first appeared 12 months before presentation
Lesion was progressively growing
Asymptomatic
No prior treatments attempted
Otherwise well
Denied fevers or weight loss
Clinical examination revealed nail thickening over the pigmented band
No other nail or skin lesions found
Histopathologic examination showed bland spindle cell proliferation
No melanocytic lesions observed
Immunostaining negative for S100 and CD34

shortlist.label: Onychomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: Bland spindle cell proliferation and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate are characteristic of onychomatricoma

shortlist.label: Nail matrix nevus
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmented lesion with nail thickening and extension to the proximal nail fold could be consistent with a nail matrix nevus

shortlist.label: Subungual fibrokeratoma
shortlist.why_kept: Fibrokeratoma can present as a pigmented nail lesion with nail thickening and can have a similar histopathologic appearance

shortlist.label: Onychocytic matricoma
shortlist.why_kept: Onychocytic matricoma can present with a pigmented nail lesion and has a similar histopathologic appearance to onychomatricoma

shortlist.label: Melanonychia
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmented nail lesion with a longitudinal band could be consistent with melanonychia, although the histopathologic findings do not support a melanocytic lesion

raw.rationale: The histopathologic examination showing bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia is consistent with onychomatricoma.

rejected.label: Nail matrix nevus
rejected.why: No melanocytic lesions were observed on histopathologic examination.

rejected.label: Subungual fibrokeratoma
rejected.why: The presence of villous fibroepithelial projections is not typical for subungual fibrokeratoma.

rejected.label: Onychocytic matricoma
rejected.why: The clinical and histopathologic findings do not match the typical presentation of onychocytic matricoma.

rejected.label: Melanonychia
rejected.why: The immunostaining was negative for S100 and the histopathologic examination did not show melanocytic lesions, making melanonychia less likely.
